metric: the corrected metric of 2026-10-16 (version 2): diag(e^{-2a4} b4 cot^2 z, e^{2a4} (x3), -1, -e^{-2a4} b4 (sin^2 z)^{1/6} (x3)), every real z

checks.name: divergence_x4_component
checks.detail: nabla_mu T^mu_x4 = -d rho/d x4 - 3 a4' (rho + p3) - 3 h4 (rho + p_t) - h4 (rho + p0), h4 = b4'/(2 b4) - a4' (both signs of sin z, i.e. every real z with sin z cos z != 0)

checks.name: divergence_x0_component
checks.detail: nabla_mu T^mu_x0 = d p0/d x0 + 3 H cot z (p0 - p_t), z = 6 H x0 (both signs of sin z, i.e. every real z with sin z cos z != 0)

checks.name: divergence_other_components_zero
checks.detail: nabla_mu T^mu_nu = 0 identically for nu = x1, x2, x3, x5, x6, x7 (both signs of sin z, i.e. every real z with sin z cos z != 0)

checks.name: ks_coordinate_jacobian
checks.detail: y = ln|sin z|/(6H) gives dy/dx0 = cot z (both signs of sin z, i.e. every real z with sin z cos z != 0)

checks.name: ks_coordinate_form
checks.detail: x0 component = cot z [p0'(y) + 3 H (p0 - p_t)]: for p0 = p_t (the field equations) it is cot z p0'(y), so p0 must not depend on y (both signs of sin z, i.e. every real z with sin z cos z != 0)

checks.name: fixture_clifford
checks.detail: gammas.json satisfies {gamma^a, gamma^b} = 2 eta^ab with eta = diag(+,+,+,+,-,-,-,-) (order x0..x7)

checks.name: vielbein_reproduces_metric
checks.detail: g_mu nu = e^a_mu e^b_nu eta_ab for the diagonal vielbein (e^x0 = e^{-a4} b4^{1/2} cot z signed, e^xt = e^{-a4} b4^{1/2} (sin^2 z)^{1/12}) (both signs of sin z, i.e. every real z with sin z cos z != 0)

checks.name: gamma_Omega_equals_hidden_block_terms
checks.detail: gamma^mu Omega_mu = (3/2) H e^{a4} b4^{-1/2} gamma^(x0) + (b4'/b4 - a4'/2) gamma^(x4) exactly: the x0 term comes from the warp of the three extra times along x0, the x4 term from the rates of x0 (-a4' + u/2), 3-space (3 a4') and the extra times (3 (-a4' + u/2)) (both signs of sin z, i.e. every real z with sin z cos z != 0)

checks.name: gamma_Omega_divergence_formula
checks.detail: gamma^mu Omega_mu = (1/2) gamma^a (1/sqrt|g|) d_mu (sqrt|g| e_a^mu) for the diagonal vielbein, computed independently (sqrt|g| = e^{-a4} b4^2 |cot z| (sin^2 z)^{1/4}) (both signs of sin z, i.e. every real z with sin z cos z != 0)

checks.name: negative_control_growing_block
checks.detail: negative control: with the block (x0, x5, x6, x7) GROWING like 3-space (scale factor e^{+a4} b4^{1/2}) gamma^mu Omega_mu = (3/2) H e^{-a4} b4^{-1/2} gamma^(x0) + (b4'/b4 + (7/2) a4') gamma^(x4): the a4' coefficient is +7/2 instead of -1/2, so the check sees the direction of the block's scale factor (both signs of sin z, i.e. every real z with sin z cos z != 0)
